bio.text: Jabari Brisport has represented New York State Senate District 25 since taking office on January 1, 2021.
Ballotpedia lists Brisport as the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Brisport was born in Brooklyn, earned a bachelor's degree from New York University in 2009 and a master's degree from Yale University in 2014, and worked as a public school teacher.
